nodes.label: Login Initiated
nodes.desc: Agent begins login using username/password. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Agent Login/Login Initiated)

nodes.label: Submit Agent ID & Password
nodes.desc: The agent can submit Agent ID and password to log in to the system. Reuses requirement TT-001-JSM-*. (Acceptance: The agent can submit Agent ID and password to log in to the system.)

nodes.label: Credential Validation Result
nodes.desc: Agent credentials are validated and Agent 360 may be shown by role. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Agent Login/Authenticated)

nodes.label: Login Failed
nodes.desc: Access is not granted. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Agent Login/Login Failed)

nodes.label: Agent 360 Dashboard Shown
nodes.desc: Agent 360: DXP agent dashboard capability through which an agent can authenticate, view profile/details, notifications, task views, and approval items. (source: 02_Glossary; Annex_02_Status_Model Agent Login/Authenticated permitted next status 'Session Active')

nodes.label: Role-Based Edit Control
nodes.desc: The System shall provide role-based view. (Acceptance: Views are enabled or disabled based on the role matrix.)

nodes.label: Initiate Forgot Password
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to initiate forgotten password flow. (Acceptance: Forgot password directs the agent to password setup and supports the confirmed identification step.)

nodes.label: Verify Identity (Authcode/OTP)
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to verify himself by providing the necessary details (Authcode or OTP). (Acceptance: Agent identity is successfully verified only when the required Authcode or OTP is valid; invalid or expired details are rejected with an appropriate validation message.)

nodes.label: Create New Password
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to create the new password as per password policy. (Acceptance: A new password is accepted only when it complies with the configured password policy and matches the confirmation value; otherwise, a clear validation message is displayed.)

nodes.label: Edit Initiated
nodes.desc: Agent opens profile edit option. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Agent Profile/Edit Initiated; trigger: Agent selects profile edit.)

nodes.label: Initiate Profile Edit
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to initiate agent profile edit from the profile section. (Acceptance: Edit profile option is available to the agent where role permits.)

nodes.label: Change Password
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change password by providing current password, new password, and confirm password. (Acceptance: Password change is accepted only after successful login and after password policy validation.)

nodes.label: Verify Identity for Password Change
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to identify himself for change password by providing necessary details (Authcode or OTP). (Acceptance: The agent can proceed to Password Change only after successful verification using a valid Authcode or OTP; invalid or expired details prevent the change and display an appropriate validation message.)

nodes.label: Update MFA Settings
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change MFA settings with privileges. (Acceptance: MFA status and authenticator/OTP setting can be updated only when permitted by role and security policy.)

nodes.label: Verify Identity for MFA Change
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to identify himself for MFA Settings by providing necessary details (Authcode or OTP). (Acceptance: The agent can proceed to change MFA settings only after successful verification using a valid Authcode or OTP; invalid or expired details prevent the change and display an appropriate validation message.)

nodes.label: Change Language
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change language from available options. (Acceptance: English and/or Arabic options are available subject to VFQ confirmation.)

nodes.label: Save Profile Changes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to save profile changes. (Acceptance: Valid profile changes are saved and invalid changes are rejected with validation message.)

nodes.label: Profile Changes Valid?
nodes.desc: source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Agent Profile/Edit Initiated permitted next status 'Saved, Cancelled'

nodes.label: Saved
nodes.desc: Profile changes are saved. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Agent Profile/Saved; trigger: Agent saves valid profile changes.)

nodes.label: View Eligible Entities
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to navigate to view entities for which access is available. (Acceptance: Entity list displays as per access rights.)

nodes.label: Choose Entity Type
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to choose the entity type before export. (Acceptance: Entity type values include Order, Ticket until VFQ confirms the complete list.)

nodes.label: Export Visible Entities
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to export all visible entity records such as Orders, and Tickets. (Acceptance: Export can be generated for visible entities irrespective of whether they are assigned to the logged-in agent.)

nodes.label: Draft
nodes.desc: Notification template/format is being used or edited. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Bell Notification/Draft; trigger: Privileged role starts notification creation.)

nodes.label: Configure Bell Notification
nodes.desc: The Backoffice role shall be able to configure bell icon notification against a customer using the defined template and expiry date. (Acceptance: Bell notification can be configured only by the permitted role.)

nodes.label: Publish Notification Manually
nodes.desc: The privileged Agent shall be able to publish bell icon notifications manually using a defined format. (Acceptance: Notification can be created from a stored template and edited before publishing.)

nodes.label: Notification Draft Outcome
nodes.desc: source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Bell Notification/Draft permitted next status 'Published, Cancelled'

nodes.label: Published
nodes.desc: Notification is displayed for applicable customer account/MSISDN. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Bell Notification/Published; trigger: Notification is published.)

nodes.label: View Bell Banner
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the bell icon notification as a banner across Customer 360 screens. (Acceptance: Notification banner is visible on Customer 360 for applicable account/MSISDN.)

nodes.label: Customer-Specific Notification Visibility
nodes.desc: The System shall display only customer account or MSISDN-specific notifications based on access permissions. (Acceptance: Agent can view notifications only for accessible customer account/MSISDN context.)

nodes.label: Sort Notifications
nodes.desc: The System shall sort customer notifications from latest to oldest. (Acceptance: Notifications display in descending chronological order.)

nodes.label: Manual Expiration Not Permitted
nodes.desc: The agent shall not be able to expire the bell icon notification manually. (Acceptance: No manual expire action is available to the agent; the bell icon notification remains visible until the configured expiry date or interval is reached, after which it is removed automatically.)

nodes.label: Expire Notification
nodes.desc: The System shall remove bell icon notification after the preconfigured expiration interval. (Acceptance: Expired notification is no longer displayed after expiry rules are met.)

nodes.label: Expired
nodes.desc: Notification removed after configured expiration interval. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Bell Notification/Expired; trigger: Expiry interval reached.)

nodes.label: Configure Bulk Notes
nodes.desc: The Backoffice role shall be able to configure bulk notes using a defined template. (Acceptance: Only a permitted Backoffice user can create or configure a bulk note using an approved template; users without the required role cannot access or submit the configuration.)

nodes.label: Apply Note to Multiple Accounts
nodes.desc: The System shall allow the same bulk note to be applied to multiple customer accounts. (Acceptance: A bulk note can be associated with one or more customer accounts.)

nodes.label: Posted
nodes.desc: Bulk note is posted and displayed. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Bulk Note/Posted; trigger: Bulk note upload/publish action; permitted next status: Posted.)

nodes.label: View Bulk Notes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view multiple notes pushed by the system with posting date and time. (Acceptance: Bulk notes display with associated date and time.)

nodes.label: Maintain Note Visibility
nodes.desc: The System shall display bulk notes irrespective of timeline after posting. (Acceptance: Posted bulk notes remain visible unless business confirms an expiry rule.)

nodes.label: Open
nodes.desc: Task created with default open status. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Task/Open; trigger: Task creation.)

nodes.label: View Task Dashboard
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view task dashboard categories including Open Tasks, In Progress Tasks, Pending Payments, Priority Tasks, and Draft Orders. (Acceptance: Dashboard shows all task categories.)

nodes.label: Display Assigned Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall display assigned tasks and priority tasks only for the logged-in agent. (Acceptance: Logged-in agent sees only task records permitted for that agent.)

nodes.label: Supervisor Task Assignment
nodes.desc: The System shall allow only the supervisor to assign tasks to team members. (Acceptance: Non-supervisor users cannot assign tasks to team members.)

nodes.label: Assigned
nodes.desc: Task is assigned based on Assigned To field. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Task/Assigned; trigger: Assignment.)

nodes.label: Navigate to Task Detail
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to navigate to detailed task view by selecting Open Tasks. (Acceptance: Selecting a task opens the task detail page.)

nodes.label: Categorize Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall categorize tasks based on priority and open task rules. (Acceptance: Task appears in the correct category after business rules are configured.)

nodes.label: Update Task Status
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to move task status to In-progress or Close. (Acceptance: Task status can be updated only through permitted lifecycle transitions.)

nodes.label: Task Status Update
nodes.desc: source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Task/Assigned permitted next status 'In Progress, Closed'

nodes.label: In Progress
nodes.desc: Agent moves task to In-progress. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Task/In Progress; trigger: Agent status update.)

nodes.label: Closed
nodes.desc: Agent closes task. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Task/Closed; trigger: Agent status update.)

nodes.label: Pending Approval
nodes.desc: Approval task is assigned to approver. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Approval Task/Pending Approval; trigger: Approval task creation/assignment.)

nodes.label: Maintain Approval Matrix
nodes.desc: The System shall maintain a configured approval matrix for each task category. (Acceptance: Approval task assignment follows configured approval matrix.)

nodes.label: View Assigned Approval Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall display all approval tasks assigned to the specific agent. (Acceptance: Approval view shows tasks assigned to the logged-in agent.)

nodes.label: Detailed View of Task
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the detailed view of the task by opening the task. (Acceptance: When the agent selects and opens an assigned approval task, the system displays the task detail view with all configured fields for that task; if the task is not assigned or accessible to the agent, access is denied.) (Note: this row has no Req ID assigned in the source.)

nodes.label: View Task History
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to see task history before confirming Approval, Rejection, or Return. (Acceptance: Task history displays Task ID, Task Name, Action Taken, and Date Time Stamp.)

nodes.label: Approve, Reject, Return
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to approve, reject, or return an approval task. (Acceptance: Approval action updates task status as per workflow and records notes where required.)

nodes.label: Add Approval Notes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to add notes for approval task status Approved, Rejected, or Returned. (Acceptance: Approval notes are captured with the approval action.)

nodes.label: Approval Outcome
nodes.desc: source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Approval Task/Pending Approval permitted next status 'Approved, Rejected, Returned'

nodes.label: Approved
nodes.desc: Approval task is approved. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Approval Task/Approved; trigger: Approver selects approve.)

nodes.label: Rejected
nodes.desc: Approval task is rejected with reason/notes. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Approval Task/Rejected; trigger: Approver selects reject.)

nodes.label: Returned
nodes.desc: Approval task is returned with notes. (source: Annex_02_Status_Model, Approval Task/Returned; trigger: Approver selects return.)

contracts.Rule Statement: Only agents granted profile-edit authority may update profile information, and they are accountable for the accuracy of the changes they submit.
An agent may request an MFA change only after identity verification and within the privileges approved by VFQ Security.
Only designated Backoffice or privileged staff may create or publish bell icon notifications and bulk notes.
Staff publishing bell icon notifications or bulk notes must use an approved template and confirm the applicable customer or account context and expiry before publication.
Only the responsible supervisor may assign or reassign tasks to members of the supervisor's team.
Only the assigned approver may approve, reject, or return an approval task; rejection or return must include the applicable reason and supporting notes.

connectivity.Purpose: Authenticate agent, process password reset, and support MFA settings.
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Login or profile change rejected and error shown.

connectivity.Purpose: Retrieve role-based view/edit permissions, profile details, notifications, and exportable entities.
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: User action restricted and open item raised.

connectivity.Purpose: Retrieve task list, task detail, approval task assignments, and update task/approval status.
connectivity.Operation: Task Query / Task Update / Approval Update
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Task action rejected and agent notified.

connectivity.Purpose: Publish or display customer account/MSISDN-level bell icon notifications and bulk notes if not stored fully in Siebel.
